div.p: The Commonwealth Franchise Act 1902 granted voting rights to most men and women over 21, excluding Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. Compulsory enrolment was introduced in 1911. Electoral rolls are available from 1903. Victoria stopped maintaining a separate State electoral roll on 31 January 1924 (the year compulsory voting was introduced), after which a joint electoral roll arrangement was entered into with the Commonwealth. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people gained the right to vote in Commonwealth elections in 1962. Federal electoral rolls include the name and address of the voter, their occupation, gender, and a registration number. The original records are held by the Australian Election Commission.
Voters were listed in electoral districts and subdistricts according to their address. These boundaries could change over time. Relevant subdivisions include:

Some entries appear to have a mismatch between the given name and the printed gender code — these have been corrected where a clear judgement can be made. This includes entries where female name and occupation (e.g. tailoress) is listed as M.
Many occupations are abbreviated and where possible these have been spelled out. Where they have been clearly misspelled, they have been corrected. For example:

Street names have been corrected where they are misspelled. Where a individual’s name and address lacks a street number, this has sometimes been added through cross-checking with street directory data.

row.cell: UPWEY.-15.8.26.---Green, Meredith, manufacturing chemist, Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his dwelling, at Upwey, a crystal wireless sett (recovered) ; 4 razors (re­covered); a pair of gent's boots, with rubber instep, size 7; a pair of tan leggings; 2 watches, with luminous dials; a black felt hat; 2 pocket knives; 2 boot brushes; and a tin of Nugget boot polish. Value £5. Entrance was effected by breaking a back window. —0.14581. 26th August, 1926.
No street number in original. In the 1925 directory, Meredith R. Green is listed at 81-83 Bouverie Street. Add number to entry.

MELBOURNE.—19.3.30.-Seward, Fred., 209 Bouverie Street, Carlton, reports stolen from Victoria-street, Melbourne, a gent's black-enamelled bicycle, "Mildura Flyer " in silver on down bar, red tire on front wheel, white tire with red tread on rear wheel, Major Taylor handles, Brooks racing saddle, B.S.A. parts. Value £5.—0.6830. 20th March, 1930.

RUSSELL STREET (M.C.P.)—24.12.3.—Stack, Michael, 156 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports finding at the corner of Rathdown and Queensberry streets, Carlton, an oblong-shaped wicker basket, size 24 x 12 inches.—0.8415. 6th April,1932.

CARLTON.—29.4.30.—Cleeland, Charlotte, grazier, Cowes, Phillip Island, reports stolen from her motor car, at 217 Bouverie-street, Carlton, a spare wheel rim, with a Dunlop tire attached, size 29 x 4.40. Value £8—0.10428. 1st May, 1930.

CARLTON.—7.4.32—Vlass, Andrew, 172 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his dwelling, a gent's blue twill suit with a white stripe; 3 shirts; 2 dozen pairs of woollen socks; a brown woollen lumber jacket; and 12 handkerchiefs. Thomas Paizis reports stolen at the same time and place, a brown Borsalino hat; a blue coat; and a torch. Gerald Drakopulos reports stolen at the same time and place, 2 poplin shirts; a silk shirt; a pair of gold-mpunted braces, "G.D." thereon; a gold-mounted amber cigarette holder and case; a green fountain pen; and a Gillette safety razor in a nickel case. Entrance was effected by forcing a rear widow.—O.8644. 8th April, 1932.

CARLTON.—9.3.32.—Smith, Lauder, is charged, on warrant, issued at the instance of Dela Marshall, 176 Bouverie-street, Carlton, with deserting his illegitimate child, at Carlton. Description:—About 18 years, about 5 ft. 11 in., well built, fair complexion and hair; wore a navy-blue suit, grey hat, and tan boots.—0.9716. 20th April, 1932.

MISSING FRIENDS: O'Brien, Garrett. is inquired for by his brother, Daniel O'Brien, care of Mr. Stark, 156 Bouverie-street. Carlton. Description:—68 years, 5 ft. 8 in., medium build, dark complexion, hair and moustache turning grey, partly bald, sharp features; wore dark clothes and black felt hat.—0.21525. 24th August, 1930.

PROPERTY FOUND: MELBOURNE NORTH. —17.9.30. - McArthur, John, 249 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports finding in Curzon-street, North Melbourne, a ring containing 9 keys and a brass tag with "Baptists" thereon.—0.24077. 20th September, 1930.

CARLTON.—5.12.31.—Brown, A. H., and Sons, 120 Bouverie-street, Carlton, report stolen from their factory, 4 pairs of shears for cutting cloth, black colour, with brass rivets; 2 cutting knives, about 26 inches long, wooden handles; a number of motor tools, including box spanners and screw-drivers; a wooden box, containing chemical weights, made of brass and metal; a number of weights, stamped 1 to 5 grams, metal weights stamped 5 to 500 milligrams; a quantity of black head-silk dressing for hats; a number of 2-in, spanners; 4 or 5 pairs of concave scissors; and 4s. or 5s. in stamps. Entrance effected by forcing a wire frame from a window and breaking the window.—0.33428. 31st December,1931.

OFFENCES OF VIOLENCE TO PERSONS. CARLTON.—26.7.29.—Yott. Frederick, motor salesman, 16 Collins-street, Essendon, reports that he was held up at the point of a revolver and robbed of an Elgin watch, with a dark leather strap, glass cracked; and about 4s. in silver; in a lane at the rear of 81 Bouverie-street, Carlton, by a man, name unknown. Description:—About 24 years, 5 ft. 4 or 5 in., slim build, abut 8 st., dark complexions, large nose, thin face; wore a dark overcoat and felt hat turned down all round.—O.16293. 28th July, 1929.

MELBOURNE.—30.7.29.—Phillips, Edward, 100 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from outside 12A shed, Australian Wharf north, a light-brown horse, light delivery sort; a light delivery cart, black wheels; and a set of second-hand harness. Value £10,—O.16698. 1st August, 1929.

OFFENCES OF VIOLENCE WITH PROPERTY. CARLTON.—21.2.25.—Johnston, Ernest Arthur, motor smith, Barkly-place, off Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his factory, a set of stocks and dies, consisting of ¼-in., 5-16-in, 3/8-in., 7-16-in., ½-in., 5/8-in., and ¾-in. sizes; and a 3/8-in. bolt cutter. Value £7 10s. Entrance was effected by forcing the lock off the front door.—O.2828. 24th February, 1925.

MELBOURNE.—29.6.25.—Bown, A. H., and Co., corner of Bouverie-street and Lincoln-square, Carlton, report stolen from their traveller’s car in Elizabeth-street, Melbourne, a large cardboard box, size 18 inches by 18 inches by 15 inches, containing 10 ladies’ Doveton velvet and velour hats, small shapes; and a cardboard box, size 14 inches by 14 inches by 12 inches, containing 9 children’s black velvet hats. Value £10.—O.9667. 39th June, 1925.
Corner of Bouverie Street ad Lincoln Square

RUSSELL-STREET.—4.8.25.—Wooley, William, newsboy, 214 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports finding in Exhibition-street, Melbourne, a key-ring, 2 Yale lock keys; a Miller lock key; and 4 small keys.—O.11823. 5th August, 1925.

NORTH WHARF.—25.6.32.—Fazino, Antonio, 180 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from No. 6 berth, North Wharf, a gent's red and black enamelled bicycle, black mudguards, turned-down racing gandles, red tires.—O.15839. 27th June, 1932.

MELBOURNE PORT.—22.4.33.—Bown, A. H., 120 Bouverie­street, Carlton, reports stolen from a motor car at the Sandridge Golf Links, Port Melbourne, a new fibre suit-case, 27 x 16 inches; a gent's grey hat; a pair of black shoes; 2 pairs of gents' golf socks; a pullover; a lumber jacket; a pair of gent’s grey trousers, faint brown stripe; a heavy double-breasted fawn and green overcoat; a pair of gent’s dark-tan gloves; and 2 sets of keys on rings.—O.9218. 23rd April, 1933.

CARLTON.—8.6.33.—Sher, Israel, 52 Bouverie-street, Carlton. reports stolen from his factory, an Underwood typewriter, No. 5/372480; 50 yards of grey suede leather cloth; 25 yards of mottled grey leather cloth; several leather and fibre suit-cases; a special Alex radiator; a Todd protectograph. Personal model; a 30-in. cabin suit-case; 3 solid leather suit-cases; 5 24-in. vulcanite fibre suit-cases; 4 pieces of moire lining; 65 dozen Japanese zip fasteners; 16 dozen British zip fasteners; 20 British suit-ease locks; 36 dozen Cheney’s suit-case locks; 39 lb. of orange-coloured thread, in balls; 3 coloured attache cases; 7 16-in. leather kit-bags, with side locks and end straps. PROPERTY FOUND. CARLTON.—28.6.38.—Spry, -, 106 Bouverie-street. Carlton, reports finding on his premises, a gent’s gabardine overcoat, lined with brown material, black patch under right arm on inside.—O.15442. 1st July, 1933.

MELBOURNE.—7.8.33.—Mamowt, Nick, is charged, on warrant, with unlawful assault of Arthur Bafues, 172 Bouverie-street, Carlton, at Melbourne. Description:—Greek, 35 years, 5 ft. 9 in., thick-set, dark hair and complexion, clean-shaven; usually wears a grey suit.—O.19094. 9th August, 1933.

CARLTON.— 1.8.32.—Roberts, Elaine, 100 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from the verandah at 65 Pelham-street, Carlton, a baby's white perambulator; a rug; and a blanket.—O.19082. 2nd August, 1932.

Jordine, William, also known as William Jordan, is missing from his home at 166 Bouverie-street, Carlton, since the 18th inst. Decsription:— Invalid pensioner, about 55 years, about 5 ft. 3 or 4 in., thin build, fair complexion, grey hair, right arm withered; wore a brown coat, navy-blue trousers, light-grey felt hat, and tan shoes.—O.21138. 23rd August, 1932.

PROPERTY FOUND. — RUSSELL-STREET.— 10.8.28.—Spry, W., c/o Cornie Boot Co., 106 Bouverie-street, carlton, reports finding in his car, in Spring-street, Melbourne, a pair of lady's second-hand black shoes.—O.16523. 11th August, 1928.

CARLTON.—13.12.28.—Ames, Jim, foreman, Fire Station, Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from the corner of Elgin and Rathdown streets, Carlton, a gent's black-enamelled bicycle, Dunlop tires, almost new, new rim on front wheel, three new spokes in front wheel, very long spring saddle, Major Taylor handles, slightly rusted. The bicycle was subsequently recovered at Frank Straker's second-hand shop, Lygon-street, Brunswick, where it was sold by a man who gave the name of J. Scott. Description:—About 40 years, about 6 feet, athletic build.—O.24889. 14th December, 1928.

MELBOURNE.—2.2.27.—Bown, A. H., and Co., Bouverie­street, Carlton, reports stolen from his motor car, in Swanston­street, Melbourne, 2 boxes, containing about 30,children's hats; and a box containing, 7 ladies' felt bats, various shades. :Value £16.—0.1844. 3rd February, 1927.

LARCENY. CARLTON.—22.3.27.—Ah Goon, fruiterer, 63 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his dwelling, a light-grey sac suit, almost new, maker’s name, "Weir," on inside of collar. —0.4830. 23rd March, 1927.

CARLTON.—21.4.27.—Wilson, Francis, grocer, 144 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his motor car, a side light; a battery; a clock; a spotlight; a pair of gloves; a cut-out; and 8 gallons of petrol. Value £16. The car was stolen from Victoria-street, Carlton, and subsequently recovered at Abbotsford.—O.6504. 25th April, 1927.

WARRANTS ISSUED. CARLTON.—7.6.27.—Hutchinson, Richard, is charged on warrant, with wilfully breaking a window in the building of Richard Fitzpatrick, dealer, 173 Bouverie-street, Carlton, at Carlton. Description: 25 years, 5 ft. 2or 3 in., medium build, fair complexion and hair.—O.13195. 27th July, 1927.
LARCENY. CARLTON.—28,1-0.27.—Civelli, Quinto, labourer; 131 Bouverie-street, Carlton, reports stolen from his room, a gramophone. Value £4 10s.—O.19278. 29th October, 1927.

RETURN OF DEALERS' LICENCES GRANTED, REBEWED, TRANSFERRED, REVOKED, OR SUSPENDED BY COURTS OF PETTY SESSIONS DURING THE MONTH OF DECEMBER, 1931.— CARLTON — 15.12.31—William Jones — 165 Bouverie Street, Carlton — Number of licence and badge: 2379

FLEMINGTON.—13.2.31.—Carlton United Breweries, 36 Bouverie-street, Carlton, report stolen from their motor lorry, in Mt. Alexander-road, Flemington, an 18-gallon kilderkin of Victoria bitter ale. Value £6. A man and woman, names unknown, suspected. Descriptions:—1st. 35 to 40 years 6 feet, very fair hair, turning bald, sharp features; wore a very light-blue dust-coat, grey trousers, and patent leather shoes. 2nd About 28 years, 5 ft. 6 in., very dark hair and complexion, Italian appearance.—O.4603. 21st February, 1931.

MELBOURNE.—22.7.31.— Naylor, Andrew, 213 Bouverie­street, Carlton, reports stolen from Elizabeth-street, Melbourne, a gent’s greenish-enamelled bicycle, Major Taylor handles, free wheel, left pedal broken, mudguard on rear tied with wire, very old.—O.20531. 23rd July, 1931.

Special inquirt is requested by the C.I. Police, Melbourne, with a view of tracing the present whereabouts of Timothy Tierney, who formerly resided at 211 Bouverie-street, Carlton. Tierney is a brother-in-law of Donald Hatfield, arrested on a number of charges of housebreaking, and is also the owner of motor car No. 50757, which is at present held by the C.I. Police. Description: Carpenter, 21 years, 5 ft. 7 or 8 in., medium build, medium complexion and hair.—O.681. 14th January, 1926.
